description: Generative design of biologics formulations via in-context learning and physics-informed decoding

intended_use.primary: Generate de novo biologics formulations for novel proteins
intended_use.input: Protein descriptors (MW, pI, Tm) + 3-10 real stability measurements
intended_use.output: 50 candidate formulation recipes ranked by predicted stability
intended_use.validation: Computational hypotheses for wet-lab screening (not clinical deployment)

limitations: Evaluation on 18 formulations (3 proteins) - scaling to 200+ planned
DLVO + Lumry-Eyring physics - simplified model, not full molecular dynamics
No wet-lab validation - computational predictions only
Only 3/5 collected proteins had sufficient in-context examples
